name: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells e-book readers, smart mobile phones and accessories, smart watches, and tablets in Turkey. The company also offers robot vacuum cleaners and smart televisions. Further, it manufactures and trades of computer peripherals and electric vehicles. In addition, it sells its products through online. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Samsun, Turkey.
